name: smwmusic-touhou-kanjuden-legacy-of-the-lunatic-kingdom-pure-furies-whereabouts-of-the-heart-stage-clear-mix
title: Touhou Kanjuden ~ Legacy of the Lunatic Kingdom - Pure Furies ~ Whereabouts of the Heart (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Pure Furies ~ Whereabouts of the Heart (from Touhou 15 Kanjuden ~ Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom) as a "stage-clear-mix." Back at it again with the Touhou stage clear themes, and it's for one of my favorite songs that I initially arranged back in 2022.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C# Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables Goal Tape SFXㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Disables Goal Tape SFX
